WHAT IS IN IT

One kit around the phone you own.One kit around the phone you own.No new case. No dock. No loose battery pack.No new case. No dock. No loose battery pack.

Active cooling

The upper grille pulls heat off the back of the phone, so the chip holds the speed it started with instead of throttling.

Power that rides along

The battery sits below the cooling section. A bidirectional USB-C port charges OGAP.

One frame, not a bag of parts

Concealed width arms and height locks. Four soft bumpers. Camera, screen edges and side controls stay open.

Tuned for this workload

Built for a phone transcribing, embedding and generating for hours, the load we see on our users' phones.

Three sizes

S, M and L. Tell us the phone you carry at checkout and we ship the size that fits.

POWER, TWO WAYS

Same frame.Same frame.You choose how it powers the phone.You choose how it powers the phone.

WIRELESS

For phones with wireless charging

The coil behind the battery body lines up with the coil in your phone. No cable between them.

OGAP COILPHONE COIL
WIRED

For phones without wireless charging

Power runs inside the frame to your phone's USB-C port. Nothing loops outside, even on phones like the OnePlus Nord 5.

OGAP OUTPUTPHONE USB-C
WHY HARDWARE, AND WHY US

We put the load there.We put the load there.So we carry the fix.So we carry the fix.

Off Grid AI Mobile runs models in your phone's memory, and its recorder keeps capture, transcription and a local model working all day. Battery and heat are the first limits our users hit.

Nothing else changes: nothing leaves your device, and the software works with or without OGAP.
